symptom: Production intermittently shows no event or vacation discovery results, the user-visible localhost trail page lacks approved nearby-content sections, and place details do not show a real saved map image.
expected_behavior: Discovery always renders an accepted durable snapshot without waiting for a supplier, dated booking revalidates authoritatively, every trail detail exposes the approved nearby families, and every inactive map shows a genuine persisted map snapshot before interaction.
environment: VII production version 536 at https://vii.spaplus.co and a stale user-visible localhost:4173 tab on 2026-10-21.

steps: Read the public event and vacation discovery endpoints.
Open a representative public trail detail and compare it with the localhost tab.
Trace cached online-capable vacations through authoritative dated quote without submitting a booking.
reproduction.evidence: Event discovery returned a stale Aurora snapshot with three real places; current vacation home-deals returned HTTP 503; public trail detail contained all four approved nearby groups while no process listened on localhost:4173; representative map snapshot endpoints returned 404.

observations.observation: The worker warmed vacation discovery but not event discovery and the vacation horizon was only two clocks.
observations.evidence: Baseline worker/index.ts and warm-vacation-discovery-cache.ts before this candidate.

observations.observation: The visitor event route could call the supplier through cachedDiscovery instead of remaining read-only.
Public trails already contain the four approved nearby groups.
observations.evidence: https://vii.spaplus.co/trails/snir-hatzbani rendered vacation, spa, attractions and providers links.

observations.observation: The localhost page is not an active candidate.
observations.evidence: No listener or owned development server exists on port 4173; the open browser tab is stale.

observations.observation: Saved map images were never generated in production.
observations.evidence: GET /api/map-snapshot for hourly-475, spa-76 and vacation-877 returned 404; release 536 evidence recorded the photo fallback because provider output was unavailable.

observations.observation: Online booking is not globally broken.
observations.evidence: No-date /search?online=1 rendered 20 cached-capability results, and dated quotes returned available positive prices for supplier sites 389, 144, 296, 11 and 1296.

hypotheses.mechanism: The tested source and the public or localhost deployment are different versions.
hypotheses.prediction: Trail markup or active process provenance diverges between public and localhost.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the localhost listener and public representative trail.
hypotheses.result: Supported: public trail includes all four groups and no process listens on localhost:4173.

hypotheses.mechanism: Scheduled warmers and visitor routes use different runtime databases or keys.
hypotheses.prediction: The public endpoint lacks the exact current key even while other snapshots exist.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Read public provenance and exact current endpoints.
hypotheses.result: Partially supported: public responses identify Aurora and the current vacation key is absent, but active schedule execution identity is still not observable from the connected workspace.

hypotheses.mechanism: Event discovery lacks scheduled durable warming and can depend on visitor-time supplier success.
hypotheses.prediction: No event warmer exists and the visitor route invokes a refreshing cache path.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect worker and visitor route boundaries.
hypotheses.result: Supported and repaired: the candidate adds a rolling seven-day event warmer and makes visitor discovery read-only.

hypotheses.mechanism: Trail source data omits approved nearby groups.
hypotheses.prediction: The public trail route lacks one or more groups.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Open a representative public trail and inspect group links.
hypotheses.result: Rejected for the reported route: all four groups are present publicly; the observed omission came from the stale localhost tab.

hypotheses.mechanism: The map preview falls back to the place photo because no persisted snapshot exists and no provider-backed reconciliation completed.
hypotheses.prediction: Snapshot endpoints return 404 and release evidence records provider output unavailable.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Probe multiple worlds and inspect release 536 evidence.
hypotheses.result: Supported. Candidate now schedules bounded self-healing reconciliation on a miss, but a configured static-map provider remains required for a real image.

fix.change: Add rolling seven-day vacation and event cache warmers, make event discovery provider-free for visitors, warm from the scheduled worker and authenticated catalog refresh, and trigger bounded background map reconciliation for known missing snapshots.
fix.evidence: Production build passed; TypeScript passed; full repository tests passed 1400/1400; focused discovery and map tests passed 29/29.
